# Preface {.unnumbered}

This small book demonstrates chapters, navigation, cross-references, and three
output formats. It uses plain Markdown and does not require Python or R.

Read @sec-writing for the writing workflow, then @sec-sharing to learn how
to share the finished book. Chapter numbers and links are managed by Quarto.

From the repository root, preview the HTML edition:

```bash
quarto preview 11-book --to html
```

The default project output directory is `11-book/_book/`.
